person.canonical_name_en: Ferdinand II of the Two Sicilies

activity.notes: Ferdinand II succeeded Francis I as king of the Two Sicilies on 8 November 1830 and reigned until his death on 22 May 1859.

sources.title: Ferdinando II di Borbone, re delle Due Sicilie — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani records Ferdinand II's accession to the throne of the Two Sicilies on 8 November 1830.

sources.title: Ferdinando II di Borbone — Dizionario Biografico degli Italiani, Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani's biographical dictionary records Ferdinand II's death on 22 May 1859.
